disclaimer.short: Decision support / educational use only. Not a diagnosis and not a substitute for formal diagnostic imaging.
disclaimer.text: These estimates come from a statistical research model trained on 303 patients from a single referral cohort. They are for decision-support and educational purposes only. They are not a diagnosis, do not show where a blockage is, and are not a substitute for formal diagnostic imaging (e.g., coronary angiography or CT angiography) or evaluation by a clinician.

population_note: Probabilities are conditional on the training population (patients referred for angiography; 71% CAD prevalence) and are not general-population risk.

targets.label: Overall CAD
targets.definition: Dataset overall CAD label (Cath = CAD). In the source data this equals >=50% narrowing in at least one of LAD/LCX/RCA for 302 of 303 patients.
targets.calibration: none (raw model probabilities; Platt/isotonic did not improve validated Brier)

targets.label: LAD stenosis
targets.definition: Whole-vessel dataset label for LAD (>=50% narrowing). A vessel-level probability only; it carries NO information about lesion location.
targets.calibration: none (raw model probabilities; Platt/isotonic did not improve validated Brier)

targets.label: LCX stenosis
targets.definition: Whole-vessel dataset label for LCX (>=50% narrowing). A vessel-level probability only; it carries NO information about lesion location.
targets.calibration: none (raw model probabilities; Platt/isotonic did not improve validated Brier)

targets.label: RCA stenosis
targets.definition: Whole-vessel dataset label for RCA (>=50% narrowing). A vessel-level probability only; it carries NO information about lesion location.
targets.calibration: none (raw model probabilities; Platt/isotonic did not improve validated Brier)

CAD.note: Strongest model. Probabilities are conditional on a referral cohort with high CAD prevalence.
CAD.evaluation: 5x5 repeated stratified CV, tuning inside training folds; CIs are patient-bootstrap on out-of-fold predictions (optimistic)

LAD.note: Moderate vessel-level discrimination; estimates partly track overall CAD risk.
LAD.evaluation: 5x5 repeated stratified CV, tuning inside training folds; CIs are patient-bootstrap on out-of-fold predictions (optimistic)

LCX.note: LIMITED vessel-specific discrimination: this estimate mostly tracks overall CAD risk and distinguishes poorly which vessel is involved among CAD-positive patients. Interpret as a coarse estimate; no hard label is provided.
LCX.evaluation: 5x5 repeated stratified CV, tuning inside training folds; CIs are patient-bootstrap on out-of-fold predictions (optimistic)

RCA.note: LIMITED vessel-specific discrimination: this estimate mostly tracks overall CAD risk and distinguishes poorly which vessel is involved among CAD-positive patients. Interpret as a coarse estimate; no hard label is provided.
RCA.evaluation: 5x5 repeated stratified CV, tuning inside training folds; CIs are patient-bootstrap on out-of-fold predictions (optimistic)

limitations: Single-centre referral cohort (71% CAD prevalence); no external validation
303 patients; 119 LCX and 114 RCA positives - CIs are wide
LCX/RCA vessel-specific signal is weak (AUC within CAD-positive ~0.58-0.62)
Vessel labels are whole-vessel (>=50% narrowing); no lesion location
Several binary flags have <10 positives in training data (CHF n=1); effects unreliable
Units for most lab values are inferred from value ranges and are UNVERIFIED against dataset documentation
BP is a single value (presumed systolic) - semantics unverified
Region RWMA and Function Class are integer codes whose meanings are not documented in the provided files; the models use them as plain numbers and no meaning is assigned to any code

consistency_warning.description: Display heuristic for a warning only (a vessel probability above CAD by more than the margin). Not a clinical or statistical threshold. Predicted probabilities are never modified.

input_policy.range_checks: informational data-support flags only; not prediction uncertainty
